quarterly_data.signal: Siemens Mobility order (release): BeNEX awarded Siemens Mobility a contract for 56 regional trains for the Mainfranken regional network - 26 four-car Desiro High Capacity and 30 three-car Mireo trains equipped with ETCS and PZB - plus connection to the Railigent X platform, spare parts packages and special tools; the trains enter service on the Frankfurt-Würzburg-Nürnberg/Bamberg routes at the end of 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: 56 trains (26 Desiro HC, 30 Mireo); service from the end of 2030
